scenes.text: This Spring-managed service has one constructor. Spring selects it automatically. Autowired is optional here.
scenes.phonemes: ðɪs spɹˈɪŋmˈænɪdʒd sˈɜːvɪs hɐz wˈʌn kənstɹˈʌktɚ. spɹˈɪŋ sᵻlˈɛkts ɪɾ ˌɔːɾəmˈæɾɪkli. ˌɔːɾoʊwˈaɪɚd ɪz ˈɑːpʃənəl hˈɪɹ.

scenes.text: Spring reads its parameter type: PaymentGateway. In our context, one matching bean is available.
scenes.phonemes: spɹˈɪŋ ɹˈiːdz ɪts pɚɹˈæmɪɾɚ tˈaɪp: pˈeɪmənt ɡˈeɪtweɪ. ɪn ˌaʊɚ kˈɑːntɛkst, wˈʌn mˈætʃɪŋ bˈiːn ɪz ɐvˈeɪləbəl.

scenes.text: Spring supplies that instance through the constructor. The service keeps the reference.
scenes.phonemes: spɹˈɪŋ səplˈaɪz ðæt ˈɪnstəns θɹuː ðə kənstɹˈʌktɚ. ðə sˈɜːvɪs kˈiːps ðə ɹˈɛfɹəns.

scenes.text: Now an order calls the injected gateway. Our test checks the same instance and the returned result.
scenes.phonemes: nˈaʊ ɐn ˈɔːɹdɚ kˈɔːlz ðɪ ɪndʒˈɛktᵻd ɡˈeɪtweɪ. ˌaʊɚ tˈɛst tʃˈɛks ðə sˈeɪm ˈɪnstəns ænd ðə ɹᵻtˈɜːnd ɹɪzˈʌlt.

scenes.text: Creating an object with new still means supplying arguments yourself. Let Spring wire the beans it manages.
scenes.phonemes: kɹiːˈeɪɾɪŋ ɐn ˈɑːbdʒɛkt wɪð nˈuː stˈɪl mˈiːnz səplˈaɪɪŋ ˈɑːɹɡjuːmənts jɔːɹsˈɛlf. lˈɛt spɹˈɪŋ wˈaɪɚ ðə bˈiːnz ɪt mˈænɪdʒᵻz.
